relay_1.label: Relay 1
relay_1.description: Switch entity of the first relay of the NSPanel

relay_1_load.label: Relay 1 connected load (W)
relay_1_load.description: Power drawn by whatever is connected to relay 1, e.g. a lamp, fan or other appliance. 0 = no load.

relay_2.label: Relay 2
relay_2.description: Switch entity of the second relay of the NSPanel

relay_2_load.label: Relay 2 connected load (W)
relay_2_load.description: Power drawn by whatever is connected to relay 2, e.g. a lamp, fan or other appliance. 0 = no load.

measure_description: Measured with the utils/measure script. The display brightness LUT was recorded while both relays were off. Relay power was measured as the constant delta when switching each relay on, one at a time, at a fixed display brightness. The 1.16 W off-state value is the display's standby consumption. The connected load of each relay is not part of the measurement and is asked for separately via the relay_1_load / relay_2_load fields.
name: NSPanel
